name: Aeza
source:
Race: Female human
Origin: Miera Village
Hobby: Cooking
Job: Traveller

Born with the ability to see ghosts, Aeza is feared by many. She rarely relies on others unless it relates to her poor sense of direction. She is actually a great cook. 

First appeared in Zeiva's early game series - Genetic Glow.
